gloss: closed day; day off; non-business day

definitions.gloss: closed day; day off; non-business day
definitions.explanation: A day on which a business, store, or facility is closed and not operating.

examples.japanese: {休業日|きゅうぎょうび}は{水曜日|すいようび}です。
{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}のお{知|し}らせが{入口|いりぐち}に{貼|は}ってある。
examples.english: A notice about closed days is posted at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}は{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}となりますので、ご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: Please note that we will be closed during the New Year holiday period.

notes:
Composed of {休業|きゅうぎょう} (business closure) + {日|び} (day). Commonly seen on signs at shops, restaurants, and public facilities to indicate when they are closed. Different from a personal day off ({休日|きゅうじつ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}: regular closing day — a fixed weekly day off
- {臨時|りんじ}{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}: temporary closure day
- {年間|ねんかん}{休業日|きゅうぎょうび}: annual closed days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}: regular closing day — the most common term on shop signs
- {休日|きゅうじつ}: holiday; day off — more general, often refers to personal days off
- {営業日|えいぎょうび}: business day — the opposite, a day when the business is open
